# Bluesky Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your Bluesky account through the AT Protocol: view profiles and home timelines, search posts, publish posts, follow accounts, and list notifications. Posts and follows need confirmation first. Uses a Bluesky app password (never your main account password), kept in Muse's secure vault. No secrets in the repo.
